# Bike maintenance

Monthly routine for the road bike.

- Clean and lube the chain; wipe off the excess.
- Check tyre pressure and look for cuts in the tread.
- Check brake pads for wear and the rotors for rub.
- Measure chain stretch every third month.

A worn chain eats the cassette. Replacing the chain early is the cheapest saving in cycling.
